about: Area watch for Chirai Moti (Bhachau, Kachchh): public developments that can affect land in and around the village. Every item needs a source link. Edited by the weekly watch task through a pull request; checked by `npm run watch:check`.

items.title: ₹991 crore approved for six-laning NH-41 between Kandla and Mundra
items.summary: The Centre approved ₹991.19 crore to widen a 57.8 km section of NH-41 between Gandhidham (Kandla) and Mundra to six lanes, with a new flyover, vehicle underpasses and bridge works. Reports say the widening stays within the existing right of way. The section is west of Gandhidham; reports do not mention the Bhachau–Chirai stretch.

items.title: Gati Shakti cargo terminals opened at Bhimasar and Shivlakha (Kachchh)
items.summary: The Railway Minister opened rail cargo terminals at Bhimasar and Shivlakha in Kachchh, among four in Gujarat, on 15 September 2026. India's first salt container train was flagged off from Shivlakha the same week.
